title: Real before/after screenshots on the Bug Ledger
summary: The standing honesty note — 'the Bug Ledger API is text-only, so screenshots are recorded as before/after metrics, not images' — is now retired. Findings carry genuine before/after image pairs, uploaded to R2, served at /api/shot, and rendered as real thumbnails on the main page and the /timeline. Fixed a HEAD 404 on served shots, taught the /timeline to render attached images (it was silently dropping them), added a client one-liner, and — per the user's report — added a scanner detector so EVERY app is checked for the 'kept the label, dropped the image' mistake.

tasks.text: Absorb the repo — worker, schemas, worklog client
tasks.desc: Read all 433 lines of the worker + schemas; found the shot pipeline was already coded, so the job was gap-closing not greenfield
Upload+serve were live; real gaps were HEAD 404, timeline dropping images, text-only protocol docs, no client helper
Route now matches GET|HEAD and returns headers-only with content-length; link unfurlers/probes no longer 404
additionCard now renders the shots the /api/activity feed was already sending; each opens the full image
'shot <file> --caption' uploads one image; AGENT.md + llms.txt now document the whole screenshot protocol agents read
Catches a shot/photo object with a caption but no image reference, and a shots/photos list mapped to just names — in every app, 0 self false-positives
Two deploys (worker HEAD fix, then docs); committed and pushed to Hallalu/bugledger
Timeline renders real before/after thumbnails; main page shows 13 shot imgs, 0 broken; HEAD 200 image/png; lightbox opens the full image

metrics.label: Shot images rendering on main page

features: HEAD support on served screenshots (with content-length)
Before/after thumbnails on the /timeline activity feed
IMG-DROP scanner detector — catches label-only image drops in every app
Screenshot protocol documented in AGENT.md + llms.txt
bugfixes: HEAD /api/shot/:key returned 404 — route matched GET only
Timeline dropped attached screenshots — /api/activity sent shots, additionCard never rendered them
Before/after screenshots requested but only names/captions stored — full photos dropped (user report)
Corrected stale detector counts in docs (41->42, 14->42)
findings: The R2 binding, D1 shots column and upload/serve endpoints already existed — the honesty note had outlived the code that made it true.
The 'pulled only names, not photos' failure is a general class (label kept, image dropped), so the durable fix is a scanner detector every app runs, not a one-off patch.
insights: A caption is metadata ON an image, never a substitute for it — persist url|dataUrl|src|blob|base64|file alongside every caption.
